headline: Nigerian Exchange Traded Funds Decline in October 2026
summary: Ten of the twelve ETFs listed on the Nigerian Exchange recorded losses in October 2026. The Stanbic IBTC ETF 30 experienced the largest monthly decline at 32.66%.
why: ETFs provide investors with exposure to specific baskets of assets; their performance reflects broader market sentiment and the underlying assets' volatility within the Nigerian financial market.

impacts.name: Stanbic IBTC ETF 30
impacts.why: The fund's net asset value decreased significantly during the period.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
